functions.name: central
functions.description: Federated likelihood ratio test for logistic regression covariates across multiple organizations without sharing raw data. Fits a full model and, for every covariate, a reduced model with that covariate dropped, via federated Newton-Raphson.

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: List of organization IDs to include in the computation.

arguments.name: outcome_col
arguments.description: Binary column defining the event / non-event outcome.

arguments.name: covariates
arguments.description: Numeric predictor columns for the full model. Categorical predictors must be encoded as numeric dummy columns beforehand.

arguments.name: positive_label
arguments.description: The value of outcome_col that denotes the event/positive outcome. Required unless the column is boolean or coded {0, 1}.

arguments.name: max_iterations
arguments.description: Safety cap on Newton-Raphson iterations per model fit.

arguments.name: tolerance
arguments.description: Convergence tolerance on the score (log-likelihood gradient), in standardized covariate units.
